department.instructions: Which team should handle this ticket?

criteria.billing: a payment the user already made is wrong: duplicate charge, invoice error, refund
criteria.technical: the product does not work: bugs, crashes, errors, outage
criteria.sales: the user wants to become a customer: pricing quote, plans, trial, contract before buying
criteria.other: general questions or how-to, not covered above

intent.instructions: What does the user mainly ask for in this ticket? Base the answer on what the user wants to happen next.

criteria.refund: be given money back for a payment that was already made
criteria.fix: have a technical problem repaired so they can keep using the product
criteria.info: receive information, pricing or a general answer
